Recognize

—

Backbone: a CNN trained on Google's QuickDraw dataset (345 hand-drawn doodle categories) — tuned for sparse line-stroke input, not photos. Your examples are embedded through this network's 512-dim feature layer, then matched by per-class nearest-neighbor similarity. Examples are saved on this device and reload automatically. Nothing leaves the device.
